info.title: CurDemoTwo Computation and Execution API
info.description: 标准计算作业不写库存；文件模式单实例，JDBC 模式支持租约调度。二维、唛架、窗帘织物规则与一维分切适配能力以 capabilities 为准。统一排程工作台覆盖需求模板、多维需求池、无副作用手调校验、方案生命周期、母卷空间图、MES 鉴权协同、采购入库/领退料/母卷报废/隔离料头放行/复检撤销/同缸补片/聚合报工分页等工厂闭环单据。支持可选企业级轻量 HMAC Bearer 认证与 5 角色 RBAC（默认关闭以兼容本地与既有自动化）；集成与 MES 通道分别使用专用 Bearer 凭据。

post.summary: Atomically move 1-100 inventory materials and post a document plus journal
post.description: Expected revision comes from options. Reserved/running materials, consumed or scrapped remnants cannot move. Quarantine status is preserved. Same key and identical command returns the original document before revision checking. Correct an old move using a new document; no delete/update. File mode supports one application instance. Operator is manually declared until authentication is implemented.

409.description: Inventory revision, reservation, material availability or idempotency conflict

Compare archived forecast results without running solvers or modifying inventory
get.description: Numeric deltas require equal hard constraints, including spare-piece limits, and equal metric unit/basis/version. Engine, time budget, objective/profile and search settings may differ. Lists changed input groups; list ordering is conservatively significant. Does not select a winner or claim optimality.

post.summary: Claim the next unacknowledged committed event

401.description: Missing or invalid integration bearer token

409.description: Busy, rejected, stale attempt, idempotency conflict or stream mismatch

post.description: At-least-once, ordered per configured consumer. Persist requestId before calling; retry unknown responses with the original body. An expired replay returns the old attempt, never grants a new token. Rejected attempts require a new requestId and retryOf equal to the rejected token. An EMPTY requestId is not persisted. Receiver must deduplicate the event ID atomically with its own changes.

post.summary: Record accepted external receipt or rejected outcome

401.description: Missing or invalid integration bearer token

409.description: Busy, rejected, stale attempt, idempotency conflict or stream mismatch

post.description: Only latest unexpired attempt may first transition. Exact completed acknowledgement replay is read-only; changed outcome conflicts. Accepted acknowledgement advances the ordered checkpoint, rejection blocks it. Does not book or reverse inventory. Maximum command body 8192 bytes.

get.summary: List immutable posted physical inventory counts, newest first

post.summary: Post a physical inventory count with balances, document, ledger and outbox in one transaction
post.description: Body <=262144 bytes. Same key and identical command replays the original receipt without advancing revision. Changed command under the same key conflicts. Reserved/running material and geometry/defect conflicts are blocked. Roll used length, reports and demand fulfillment stay unchanged. A found remnant is quarantined. Correct with a new document; no deletion or rewrite. INTERNAL inventory authority and single-process file mode only. Unknown outcomes must retry the identical key and body.

400.description: Invalid JSON, fields, dimensions or idempotency key

409.description: Revision, reservation, geometry, material or idempotency conflict

holes.description: CONTOUR only. Optional interior hole rings (each ring >= 3 vertices, strictly inside outer contour).

avoidancePolicy.description: Optional defect avoidance policy overriding default severity rules.

allowHalfTurn.description: CONTOUR only. With allowRotation false, true permits 0 and 180 degrees. Full rotation permission still permits all four quarter turns.

maxStages.description: GUILLOTINE only. Optional maximum guillotine cutting stages (1-16).

initialPlacements.description: Optional complete starting layout. The server rebuilds the outlines from the order and validates the geometry before using it.

gapFillLimits.description: Marker v2 only. Maximum extra pieces for each existing part ID within the complete marker. Job fulfillment excludes these spare pieces.

phase.description: Identifies a validated starting layout, a fixed-width strip search, or a contour compaction attempt. Omitted for ordinary length-search trials.

gapFillPlacements.description: Verified spare pieces inside the occupied marker, separate from layout.placements. Returned with markerAreaUtilizationWithFill. An empty list contributes zero spare area.

maxKnives.description: Optional maximum simultaneous strips/knives per slitting car (1-100).

minBladeSpacingMm.description: Optional minimum physical blade spacing in mm (1-100000).

forbiddenNarrowEdgeMinMm.description: Optional forbidden narrow tail edge lower bound in mm (paired with forbiddenNarrowEdgeMaxMm).

forbiddenNarrowEdgeMaxMm.description: Optional forbidden narrow tail edge upper bound in mm (paired with forbiddenNarrowEdgeMinMm).

kerfMm.description: Optional kerf loss per cut between adjacent strips in mm (0-500).

candidateRollWidths.description: Optional multi-width mother roll pool for joint width selection.

SlittingProblem.description: 宽度与卷长为整数 mm，非整米卷长保持精确值。ID唯一，候选宽度不超过扣边可用幅宽；需求总卷数+超产上限<=100000。跨字段约束由服务验证。

reverses.description: 同账户来源流水关联；批次共享余额可只冲销部分数量，以 beforeJson / afterJson 为实际变化

beforeJson.description: 规范化 JSON 余额及几何；空为不存在

afterJson.description: 规范化 JSON 余额及几何；空为移除

operator.description: Manually declared operator; not authenticated identity.

CountObservation.description: Measured physical presence. Present requires positive length; absent requires zero length and unchanged width. Roll width is fixed, length is uncut remaining length. A missing remnant retains historical geometry but has zero book area; finding it restores QUARANTINED status.

operator.description: Manually declared; not an authenticated identity.

differenceAreaM2.description: Signed change in inventory area, m2; not production output or cutting waste.

CountOptions.description: One read-only inventory snapshot; includes unavailable and LOST items with eligibility/reason. LOST dimensions are historical geometry, not available stock. Never silently update expectedRevision after physical measurements have been checked.

FabricRule.description: Optional fabric-level rule for curtain selvedge exclusion and bi-axial pattern repeat.

PartRule.description: Optional per-part rule for MAIN/AUXILIARY role, bi-axial pattern matching, discrete allowed angles, and consistent grain group.

allowedAnglesDeg.description: CONTOUR only. Discrete allowed rotation angles in integer degrees [0, 359].

grainGroupId.description: Optional consistent nap/grain group identifier; all parts sharing a grainGroupId use the same warp orientation (0 or 180 deg).

ValidateLayoutRequest.description: 纯计算只读手调布局几何校验与刀路/余料重建请求（绝不写库存）。

IntegrationBearer.description: Dedicated host-configured credential for one external consumer. Disabled by default; this is not authentication for the other APIs.

BearerAuth.description: 企业级轻量认证 Bearer 令牌（cutdemo.auth.enabled=true 时生效，通过 POST /api/v2/auth/login 获取，支持 ADMIN/PLANNER/OPERATOR/INSPECTOR/WAREHOUSE 五角色 RBAC）。

MesBearer.description: MES 协同接口专用 Bearer 令牌（cutdemo.mes.auth-required / cutdemo.mes.token）。
